final_message:
I implemented `encode` and `decode` in `runcodec/codec.py` following the README, including the digit and backslash escaping. The three tests in `tests/` pass.

I also ran a random round-trip check on 20,000 strings built from `a`, `1`, `0` and `\`. Every one satisfied `decode(encode(s)) == s`. The error cases from the README (`0a`, `05a`, `12`, `a3`, and a trailing backslash) all raise `ValueError`. `2a` and `1a` decode to `aa` and `a`, as the README allows.

I did not add any new tests to the repo.
